mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_platform_settings WHERE enabled = 1 AND connection_status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provider_webhook_inbox WHERE status = 'BLOCKED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provider_webhook_inbox WHERE status = 'RETRYABLE_FAILED'

SELECT s.id AS setting_id, s.store_id, s.platform_type AS provider, s.external_store_id, s.enabled, s.connection_status, s.last_error_code, MAX(CASE WHEN i.status IN ('BLOCKED', 'RETRYABLE_FAILED') THEN i.updated_at END) AS last_error_at, SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'BLOCKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unresolved_blocked_count FROM store_platform_settings s LEFT JOIN provider_webhook_inbox i ON i.resolved_setting_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.store_id, s.platform_type, s.external_store_id, s.enabled, s.connection_status, s.last_error_code ORDER BY COALESCE(last_error_at, s.last_webhook_at, s.last_success_at) DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT i.id AS inbox_id, s.store_id, i.platform_type AS provider, s.external_store_id, i.external_order_id, i.status AS processing_status, i.last_error_code, i.updated_at AS last_error_at FROM provider_webhook_inbox i LEFT JOIN store_platform_settings s ON s.id = i.resolved_setting_id WHERE i.status IN ('BLOCKED', 'RETRYABLE_FAILED') ORDER BY i.updated_at DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
